notes: tapFrac values are the real RectTransform centres resolved over the 1242x2688 reference canvas (anchorMin/Max + anchoredPosition + sizeDelta, through every nested prefab instance), then mapped through the SafeArea/AspecterSA letterbox: a UI rect at panel fraction u sits at 0.013042 + u*0.973917 of the screen from the bottom, so tapFracY = 1 - that. Width maps straight across (x/1242). Recomputed against the current scenes - the previous file predated the pop/HUD re-layout. The runner waits out the app's own loader before step 1, so step 1 lands on the menu rather than the splash, and the PLAY tap uses waitLoader because Menu -> Game is a scene change with its own loader. Step 3 picks CLIMB, not the already-selected RUSH: re-selecting the default repaints nothing and would have produced a near-duplicate of step 2, which the duplicate-frame gate rejects. The run ends on the pause pop (SETTINGS.POPS.PAUSE, 6), which is reachable on demand; WIN/LOSE depend on where the sweeping module happens to be and cannot be guaranteed inside a fixed tap budget - two drops can never end a run (a complete miss needs |delta| >= the module width, which is wider than the whole sweep span, and the first 3 placements are grace-protected anyway).
